put.description:
Switch between demo and real. Refused while a chain or trade is running. REAL also needs the
owner's permission (`PUT /account/real-trading`, decision D-15) and the owner's password again:
this is the one request that makes trades use real money.

Allow, or stop allowing, the switch to the REAL account. Needs the owner's password. It is
written to the risk log. Taking it back is refused while REAL is the account in use.

post.description:
End the chain at once, so the group is free for new signals (the dashboard's "skip to
base"). An open trade still settles and is recorded, but nothing follows it.

Let the open trade settle, then end the chain without a further step. Repeating it is
harmless.

get.description: Whether the engine is running, why it is not, and which logins it has.

post.description: Stop and start again, for example after changing a stored login.

Start the engine on the DEMO account: it connects to Quotex and Telegram and begins taking
signals. Does nothing if it is running. 409 `engine_start_failed` says why it could not.

Stop the engine. Trades that are open stay open on Quotex and run to their expiry; here they
are marked `unknown` straight away (the application can no longer follow them).

engine stopped.
